title: Conditional reference-impact and strict-quality routing for template adopters
rawUserRequest: reference-impact 属于全仓库级检查，strict quality 会并行执行多组治理检查；在没有必要的情况下不要触发这些耗时检查。不止优化当前清理残留记录 WI，要按情况优化未来 WI，并把能力同步到未来安装对象工程。

preReviewWarnings: Review that not-applicable reference-impact paths do not load or evaluate repository records, while impact-bearing paths remain enforced.
Review that targeted strict routing never lowers release, dependency, trust, workflow, installer, unknown, or explicit human-strict verification.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: For a changed scope with no reference-impact operation class, check-ai-reference-impact writes an auditable not_applicable decision and does not load or evaluate existing repository records.

For an impact-bearing changed scope, check-ai-reference-impact still requires covering records and fail-closes on missing, invalid, or non-continue record decisions; explicit record evaluation remains unchanged.

Strict quality routing selects a targeted required-group set for non-release, non-high-risk governance changes, while release, dependency, trust, workflow, installer, unknown, and explicit human-strict routes retain full quality.
Routing receipts expose the selected target, reason, and required groups sufficiently for reviewers to distinguish skipped work from completed work.
Makefile and templates/make/Makefile.ai implement equivalent conditional behavior, and an isolated future-adopter/template parity regression proves the portable entrypoint receives the capability.
Focused tests, repository AI checks, and declared project quality checks pass without changing the meaning of mandatory controls.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The current Makefile dispatches every existing reference-impact record before it knows whether the current Contract and changed paths have an impact-bearing operation. Strict quality also fans out multiple governance groups for every strict-profile change, even when some groups are unrelated to the changed domains. Because Makefile.ai is the future adopter entrypoint, fixing only this repository would leave installed projects with the same cost behavior.
constraints: Keep reference-impact evidence fail-closed whenever the current change requires it.
Never downgrade release, dependency, trust, workflow, installer, unknown, or explicit human-strict work.
Preserve existing public quality targets and installed-template behavior.
Keep routing deterministic, auditable, local, and testable without provider calls.
intent.rationale: Compute applicability before scanning expensive repository evidence, and route strict quality by changed-domain necessity while retaining full escalation for high-risk cases. Mirror the implementation in the portable Makefile template so future installed adopters inherit the optimization.

declaredIntent.summary: Conditionally execute repository-wide reference-impact and strict quality groups while preserving fail-closed high-risk governance and syncing the behavior to future adopter templates.
